description: Offline AI text-to-speech desktop app with natural voices and local speech synthesis.
notes: Review status: the official v2.1.2 Windows x64 release provides an NSIS setup EXE. Its SHA-256 is pinned to the digest published in the GitHub Release metadata and on the official website.

The upstream NSIS customInstall routine extracts vc_redist.x64.exe and silently installs the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable, which is required by onnxruntime-node. The release does not publish a separate Windows portable archive or a documented portable-mode switch.

Windows GitHub Actions run 41455667327 downloaded the official installer, verified its SHA-256, and successfully extracted the NSIS container with 7-Zip. The application is not directly at the NSIS extraction root: the installer contains $PLUGINSDIR/app-64.7z, whose second-stage extraction exposes Out Loud.exe. The outer payload also contains $PLUGINSDIR/vc_redist.x64.exe. Upstream build-resources/installer.nsh confirms that the vendor setup silently installs the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable because onnxruntime-node requires it. This manifest remains under review: a Scoop post_install second-stage extraction, cleanup, launch/shim/shortcut, persistence behavior, and safe runtime dependency handling still need implementation and validation.
